identity.title: Default-Off Attended-Signing Rules-Based NBA Micro-Risk Live Pilot under a Hermes Strategy-Level Gate
identity.objective: Add one finite default-off attended-signing rules-based pilot composer that takes a per-wallet run lock, reconciles first, admits at most one verified pregame NBA moneyline FOK BUY per invocation, chosen by a deterministic total order, through the unchanged Gate C, LIVE-ORCH and Gate B kernel under an owner-recorded bounded policy, with pilot caps enforced inside the native wallet lock, or records a durable NO_TRADE; limit price pinned to fresh token best ask (no repricing)

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the 16 paths; default None hook restores native canary behavior; no store schema, risk constant, Gate B/C or feeder change to unwind.

api_matrix.reason: One narrow protected hook plus one new composer API.

items.after: optional in-lock fail-closed callable, default None; same non-None call-site block resamples native time after guard, rechecks permit window and uses resampled admission time
items.compatibility_requirement: All existing callers unchanged when None

items.after: run_pilot_once(*, policy_path, owner_record_path, owner_record_sha256, state_root, feeder_root, dependencies=None) and foreground main run: run lock, policy and owner-record validation, latched kill check, reconcile even when killed, stop unless NO_NEW_EXPOSURE_READY and kill clear/unlatched, intake, NO_TRADE or one deterministically selected FOK BUY via native canary; one candidate at fresh best-ask only, native FOK BUY intent literals (AGGRESSIVE_TAKER, post_only false, expiry null); no price search or share rounding
items.compatibility_requirement: No Gate B client, order literal, env secret or loop

semantic_fields.reason: Each protected behavior maps to one semantic path.

items.expected_result: Default None hook leaves existing canary behavior unchanged; unchanged default None clock-call sequence

Guard raise or non-None return yields zero admission and zero transmit, in lock; guard runs after final host geoblock and permit-window checks and before build_admitted_episode; post-initial-authority lifecycle pause/revoke/change and superseding Hermes during authentication/prepare cause zero admission/transmit; event-start/feeder-age/Hermes-age crossing there likewise refuses; native permit expiry during guard I/O returns PERMIT_EXPIRED with zero admission/transmit; success records post-guard sampled time in build_admitted_episode and admit_and_transmit; exact expiry rejects and just-before-expiry positive control succeeds

Policy or owner record that is non-canonical, digest-mismatched, scope or window mismatched, or has any value absent, invalid or above the hard ceilings, yields no order and zero native calls; finite plain decimals, malformed/null/type/empty/duplicate/unknown fields reject; zero experimental margin is a valid positive control

Third admission in 24h and total commitment over cap refused inside the lock; concurrent pilot invocation refused by the run lock with zero native calls; late lifecycle policy/allocation/head pause/revoke/change is detected by native authority revalidation in the held wallet lock

FOK intent is BUY/AGGRESSIVE_TAKER/post_only=false/expiration null; limit price EXACTLY the fresh token best ask, no price search; cap/best ask is exact at 2dp without rounding, else MINIMUM_EXCEEDS_CAP; stress notional is shares * limit not swept VWAP; depth, delay, native cap, Hermes age and experimental margin checked; pair selection ranks stress EV, start_ns, token_id; research-only labels never claim robust unconditional EV; Hermes age rechecked after TTY/prepare at final guard with exclusive event start and inclusive maximum age: future or over-age rejects, exact maximum and just-inside controls pass

Stale tampered or started-game feeder data gives durable NO_TRADE; forged derived probability, negative/future age, contradictory same-event identities and duplicate pairs reject; source-derived selection independent of directory order; final guard rechecks every bound source receipt age and pregame start after TTY/prepare: exact start and over-age/future reject; exact maximum age and just-inside controls pass

Kill flag blocks admission at all three checks, including a flag raised after prepare, while reconcile runs; entry kill flag still runs reconcile; flag removed during reconcile stays latched and prevents intake/preflight/canary; unsuccessful reconcile prevents admission
Non-allowlisted or failing provider yields no order

Unrelated market under whitelisted version is refused; unchanged public verify_permit_authority rerun on same bound permit/intent/stores at latest-point hook, late REVOKE/PAUSE_NEW_EXPOSURE and superseding Hermes assessment refuse without alternate candidate or regenerated permit
Crash after admission never produces a second transmit
Exactly one truthful terminal per invocation; malformed and credential-like synthetic input sentinels never appear in terminal or exception diagnostics

Live status DISABLED and source guards unchanged; both historically frozen architecture comparisons recognize exactly one literal pilot approval block, strip only approved historical blocks, retain all frozen base SHAs/equality/security/sibling/tail assertions and pass their original exact pytest nodes
